teach.empty: No classes have been assigned to you yet. Once assigned by the department head, your classes will appear here.
teach.helpBody: This list shows the classes you teach (not the courses you are enrolled in as a student). Instructor assignments are managed by the department head; if you do not see a class, no class has been assigned to you yet. Click "Grading Queue" to grade submissions, or "Enter Grades" to submit final grades.
teach.intro: The classes assigned to you are listed here. From each class, you can access the gradebook, student roster, grade entry, and grading queue.
teach.title: My Courses

help.body: This dashboard provides a summary of your academic status: open tasks, the next session, cognitive profile, and recent certificates. Use the "Join Next Class" button to enter the live class and view the weekly schedule with "Full Calendar".

instructor.empty: No classes have been assigned to you yet. Once assigned by the head of the department, classes will appear here.
instructor.helpBody: The classes assigned to you are listed here — along with the weekly schedule, capacity, and number of enrolled students. Click "Enter Grades" to submit grades, "Gradebook" for the gradebook, and "Live Class" to hold a class. If you don't see any classes, instructor assignments are handled by the head of the department.

notif.helpBody: All your notifications are gathered here. Clicking any notification marks it as read and takes you to the related page. Use the "Unread" tab to see only new notifications, and use the button at the top of the page to mark all as read at once.
notif.title: Notification Inbox

help.title: Organization Dashboard Guide
help.body: This page provides an overview of your organization: active members, assigned seats, and overdue invoices, alongside current term courses and study programs. A value shown as “—” means it has not yet been registered in the system — for instance, until the finance department registers the contract seat limit, “Total Contract Seats” will show no number.

progress.helpBody: This page provides a real-time summary of your academic status: average grade, active and completed courses, class attendance, and AI assistant interactions. The "Next Steps" section shows recommended tasks, and "Shortcuts" let you jump directly to course registration, transcripts, and other pages.
